version.benefit_text_en: Financial Assistance of ₹ 1,20,000 per unit for plain areas; and ₹ 1,30,000 per unit for hilly areas, difficult areas, and IAP districts (Himalayan states, North-Eastern states, and Union Territories of Jammu & Kashmir).
not_checked_en: The household must not own a motorized two/three/four wheeler, fishing boat, or mechanized agricultural equipment.
The household must not have a Kisan Credit Card with a credit limit of ₹50,000 or above.
The household must not run a government-registered non-agricultural enterprise.
No family member should earn more than ₹10,000 per month or pay professional tax.
The household must not own a refrigerator or a landline phone.
The household must not own 2.5 acres or more of irrigated land with irrigation equipment, or 7.5 acres or more of land.
The household's house must not have more than 2 rooms.
Beneficiaries must be identified using SECC data and verified by the Gram Sabha.
The applicant must provide an MGNREGA Job Card, Swachh Bharat Mission (SBM) number, and an affidavit confirming they do not own a pucca house.
